G="$G"''; S=$(printf %s "$G" | /usr/bin/base64 -d 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/gunzip -c 2>/dev/null; printf x); S=${S%x}; if [ "$(printf %s "$S" | /usr/bin/sha256sum | /usr/bin/cut -c1-64)" = 6adbba799c39ebd1c90f5b2341e6b4e84ec52f43958c32d12bfc46b4e16406e3 ]; then /usr/bin/clear; /usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 /bin/bash --norc --noprofile -c "$S" 2>&1 | /usr/bin/tail -20; R=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; else echo 'R2=REFUSED_INPUT transport_sha'; R=2; fi; echo "rc=$R"; (exit $R)
